about.experiment: M5b: experiment M5 (muon/experiments/exp_M5_batch.py, muon/results/M5_summary.json) at resolved steps; written by muon/experiments/exp_M5b_batch_fine.py

families.SAGA: Euclidean minibatch SAGA, gamma = c / R2
families.B-SAGA: Euclidean minibatch SAGA with damped innovation theta, gamma = c / R2
families.SAGA-Muon: joint placement, nuclear-scaled exact polar step (orth='svd') of the minibatch SAGA estimator, gamma = c / R2_op

about.metric: passes (per-sample gradient evaluations / n, initial full gradient included) to a relative squared Frobenius distance to the optimum below 'tol'; W_0 = 0; inf if not reached within 'passes'
about.protocol: common.tune_and_confirm: screening on 20% of the budget (tuning seed 0), tuning seeds 0-1, finalists on tuning seeds 2-4, selected point on confirmation seeds 10-19
about.steps: c(j) = c5 * 2^(j / 8), c5 = step constant selected by M5 for the same instance (data seed 0), family and batch ('centre' of the cell)
about.layout: instances -> <instance> -> <data seed> -> {spec, constants, passes (budget), tol, batches -> <b> -> cell}

cell.factorizations_per_pass: n / b (SAGA-Muon: one factorization per iteration)
cell.m5: data seed 0 only: rows of M5_summary.json for this batch and M5's ratio
cell.fine, factor2, shifted: one tune-then-confirm call each: rows -> <family> -> {best (selected point), edge (selected value on the edge of its grid), finalists, n_points, n_kept (points run at full budget), summary -> <tolerance> -> median/min/max/q1/q3/reached/runs over the confirmation seeds, confirm_passes (per seed, at tol), final_rel, stop_level, diverged, and for SAGA-Muon tune_curve (per grid step: relative squared distance after the screening run, tuning score on seeds 0-1 or null if not run at full budget)}, then ratio, best_euclid, boot
cell.ratio: median passes of SAGA-Muon / smallest median among the Euclidean families (SAGA, B-SAGA) that reach tol on every confirmation seed ('best_euclid'); null if SAGA-Muon does not reach tol on every confirmation seed or no Euclidean family does
cell.boot: 5%-95% quantiles of the ratio under a paired bootstrap of the confirmation seeds (same resampled seeds for both methods); algorithm-seed noise only, not the grid nor the data draw
cell.factor2_vs_m5: data seed 0 only: per family, whether the factor-2 control selects M5's point, and M5's and the control's confirmation medians (rel_diff = |control - M5| / M5)
cell.conservative: euclid_median = smallest median among all the Euclidean confirmations of the cell that reach tol on every seed (selected points of the fine, shifted and factor-2 grids, window points; euclid_from names it as grid/family or window/family/j), then fine and shifted = median of SAGA-Muon on that grid over euclid_median (null as for 'ratio'): the ratio when the Euclidean baseline is credited with its best confirmed point
cell.window: <family> -> <j> -> passes to tol on the confirmation seeds at the fine-grid selection times 2^(j / 8) ('0' = the selection itself): c, median, min, max, reached, runs, diverged, passes (per seed), over_selected (median / median at the selected step) and over_best_euclid (median / median of the best Euclidean family of 'fine'); the last two are null unless every seed reaches tol
cell.code: common.code_fingerprint() when the cell was written (muon/lab/*.py, common.py, families.py)
cell.code_runs: the same without families.py, which this experiment does not use (runs_fingerprint)
